newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Electronics to cut chip investment.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Electronics to cut chip investment.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, flagship unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Tuesday it planned to cut investment for semiconductors to two trillion won in 1997 from 2.2 trillion this year.
"A slump in sales of memory chips as a result of a sharp price fall was the reason for the smaller investment," said Lee Eun-kyong, a spokeswoman at Samsung Electronics.
She said investment for production facilities would fall to 1.5 trillion won next year from 1.8 trillion won earmarked for this year.
But research and development investment would increase to 500 billion won in 1997, compared with 400 billion in 1996.
Samsung's semiconductor sales totalled 7.7 trillion won in 1995. Officials at Samsung refused to give estimates for this year's sales.
